Aseko RS485 communication protocol v 1
aseko_rs485_com_protocol_v1.txt
ASEKO RS485 communication protocol
==================================
2025 February

Note! This is information of what I know. 

MAIN, ASIN AQUA, HOME & SALT
============================

Hexadecimal
Unit sends data 1 x 10 sec
Speed 57600 bauds
pH, CL is send with 2 decimal numbers
Temperature is send with 1 dec. number
Measured values ff - error value

Communication should look like this:
0A 41 03 CF 00 00 00 00 00 C0 00 00 00 00 01 00 46 00 19 05 03 08 FF 00 02 00 40

ALL UNITS - MAIN ---------------------------------------------------

  1.byte: 0ah 
  2.byte: unit type
          low 4 byte 0-3bit
            0 bit, 1' CL probe
            1 bit, 1' RX probe
            2 bit, 1' no probe DOSE
            3 bit, 1' no probe Sanosil
          high 4 byte 4 - 7 bit
            4 bit ,1' aqua
            5 bit ,1' salt
            6 bit ,1' home 
            7 bit ,1' profi

  3.byte:   pH high byte
  4.byte:   pH low byte
  5.byte:   RX or CL high byte
  6.byte:   RX or CL low byte
  7.byte:   CL or RX high byte
  8.byte:   CL or RX low byte
  9.byte:   temperature high byte
  10.byte:  temperature low byte
  11.byte:  error_1 - 00h no error, >00h yes error
  12-17.    byte - serial number
  16.byte:  ff level over 200 cm
            : fe level sensor is disconnected
  17.byte   required pH - 1 dec. number
  18.byte   required CL or Rx - with CL 1 dec. number with RX must multiply 10x 
  19.byte   required temperature - no dec. number
  20.byte   required flocc 1 dec. number
  21.byte   not used
  22.byte   state relay
  23.byte   not used
  24.byte   error_2 - 00h no error, >00h yes error
  25.byte   not used
  26.byte   not used
  27.byte:  crc - aah xor 1.byte xor....xor 26.byte

UNIT SPECIFIC - ASIN AQUA -------------------------------------------------------------

  byte 11 error_1
    0 bit ,1' 10 or 15 or 25 doses of pH without a change of pH value 
    1 bit ,1' 30 doses of CL without a change of CL value
    2 bit ,1' no flow to the probes
    3 bit ,1' no ph dose too rapid value change

  byte 24 not used

  byte 22
    0 bit ,1' dose pH
    1 bit ,1' dose CL(Rx,sanosil)

UNIT SPECIFIC - HOME ------------------------------------------------------------------

  byte 11 error_1
    0 bit ,1' hour dose exceeded
    1 bit ,1' time correction error
    2 bit ,1' no flow to the probes
    3 bit ,1' empty buffer tank
    4 bit ,1' buffer tank overflow
    5 bit ,1' low filling speed
    6 bit ,1' 20 doses of pH without a change of pH value 
    7 bit ,1' 30 doses of CL without a change of CL value
  byte 24 not used
  byte 22 - relay
    0 bit ,1' filter backwash
    1 bit ,1' filling
    2 bit ,1' heating
    3 bit ,1' filtration
    4 bit ,1' algicid (pH+) 5 bit ,1' flocc
    6 bit ,1' CL
    7 bit ,1' pH-
    
UNIT SPECIFIC - SALT -----------------------------------------------------------------

  byte 11 error_1
    0 bit ,1' hour dose exceeded 
    1 bit ,1' time correction error 
    2 bit ,1' no flow to the probes 
    3 bit ,1' empty buffer tank
    4 bit ,1' buffer tank overflow 
    5 bit ,1' low filling speed
    6 bit ,1'
    7 bit ,1'

  byte 24 error_2
    0 bit ,1’ high power, over 22A on electrodes
    1 bit ,1' low salt under 4g/l
    2 bit ,1' low salt under 4,5 g/l
    3 bit ,1' low pH under 7,3
    4 bit ,1' too low pH under 6,7 turn OFF electrolysis

  byte 22
    0 bit ,1' dose pH
    1 bit ,1' dose CL (Rx,sanosil)
  byte 22 - rele
    0 bit ,1' error (will be filter backwash) 
    1 bit ,1' filling
    2 bit ,1' heating
    3 bit ,1' filtration
    4 bit ,1' start of electrolysis
    5 bit ,1' algicid
    6 bit ,1' direction of the electrolysis 
    7 bit ,1' pH-
